selectedAssets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short bronze-blue, pearl-lilac, ruby-ivory, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear gradient rainbow thigh-high stockings and heels beside the Neris in Vilnius, with Gediminas Tower rising above the riverfront.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and emerald RAZE looks wear rainbow knee-high stockings and heels on Kaunas's tree-lined Laisvės Alėja, with a stylized mushroom-shaped smoke cloud far behind them.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze, pale rose, teal-black, and plum-green RAZE looks wear metallic knee-high statement boots with rainbow bands and split-star heels beside the lake at Trakai Island Castle.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze-teal, pearl-blue, ruby-black, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear solid-color knee-high stockings and heels on the Parnidis Dune boardwalk above the Curonian Lagoon, with stylized smoke far across the water.
